counter.title: Counter Strafing HUD
counter.consoleDesc: Choose a display mode, start recording, and finish setup
counter.dataDesc: Summary stats, trends, and latest results for counter-strafing and shooting stability
counter.guideDesc: How shooting stability, counter-strafing grades, and metrics work
counter.keysDesc: Customize movement, crouch, and fire keys
counter.advancedDesc: Movement model, sampling calibration, and grading thresholds
counter.restartSteps2: Find the app on your desktop or Start menu
counter.restartSteps4: Return here and select “Start recording” again
counter.keyMapDesc: Customize movement, crouch, and fire bindings
counter.judgementDesc: Tune stability grading, counter-strafe assessment, and history windows
counter.historyCountDesc: Shared by both charts and used for average error, stable rate, and standard deviation
counter.assessmentHelp: Thresholds become progressively stricter; switches outside the valid window are ignored
counter.shootingHelp: Default low-speed window: 180ms. Default error threshold: 0.35; lower values are stricter.
counter.movementModelDesc: Tune acceleration, counter-strafe braking, and natural deceleration
counter.fireSamplingDesc: Align sampling with CS2 shot timing
counter.crouchWindowDesc: Stability grace and error recovery after releasing crouch
counter.maxSpeedHelp: Default 1.0. Higher values model faster movement and produce more red bars.
counter.accelerationHelp: Default 5.5. Higher values reach movement speed sooner; lower values model a slower start.
counter.counterBrakeHelp: Default 14. Controls how quickly an opposite key brakes movement to zero. Higher values make counter-strafing stop faster.
counter.naturalDecelHelp: Default 2.5. Controls how quickly movement coasts to a stop after releasing a key.
counter.accurateRatioHelp: Default 0.34, approximately CS2’s accurate-speed threshold. Lower values require a more complete stop.
counter.firstShotHelp: Default 18ms. Delay between Mouse 1 and the sampled movement speed.
counter.tapHelp: Default 90ms. A press shorter than this records one tap instead of automatic fire.
counter.autoFireHelp: Default 100ms. Sampling interval while Mouse 1 is held; it does not affect tap grading.
counter.crouchGraceHelp: Default 45ms. Shots inside this window after releasing crouch remain stable.
counter.crouchRecoveryHelp: Default 90ms. Transition back to normal error after the crouch-release grace period.
